details:
When turning off both controllers the Vrchat one handed hud menu that normally appears above the wand will stay at either the far left or far right of the peripheral vision and is locked to the head. Similar to the microphone or face mirror hud.

What is expected to happen when both controllers are off: 

The one handed hud should not be visible.

Weird edge case: When turning off both controllers off at the same time there is a slight change that the one handed hud will not appear. I have figured out that this happens roughly once every 10 tries.

Personal note:

I recently found out that I enjoy sleeping in vr with friends. Sometimes I turn off my controllers when I plan to sleep more than 6 hours because my knuckles would die. I want to cuddle my friend and give him a headpat before logging off. You can’t do that with a dead controller. But what never really bother me now has become an issue because I have an vive pro now. The oled headset and lenses make this hud really bright and there is a lens flare visible. This is really distracting and kinda ruins the immersion. For now I have lived with being forced to turn on and off the controllers multiple times until the hud disappears. But this is not the ideal solution.

~Komi
title: One handed hud visible in peripheral vision when both controllers are being turned off.
